$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFEJ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-01-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Châteauroux - Villers

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
WDI: possible wrong indications when SE wind.
Pilots' attention is drawn towards the implementation of IFR and training procedures for wide bodied aircraft in the vicinity of CHATEAUROUX-DEOLS.
Lack of visibility between the two THR, extreme caution is required.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Instructions when the CTR CHATEAUROUX is activated: Aerodrome-circuits: regarding Villers circuits, squawk 7057 and contact CHATEAUROUX TWR as soon as possible.
Inform systematically CHATEAUROUX TWR at the end of session.; Arrivals: before entering CTR, get imperatively a clearance from CHATEAUROUX TWR.

To join Villiers aerodrome circuit, proceed to a Villers overhead at 1500 ft without overshooting east from Villers runway centerline.; Departures: contact CHATEAUROUX TWR as soon as possible to get a clearance.
As long as a radio contact has not been established, keep west from Villers runway centerline at 1500 ft QNR maximum waiting for clearance getting; possible exit to the west at 1500 ft.
Others sectors: compulsory clearance of CHATEAUROUX TWR.
Manche à vent : possibilités d'indications erronées par vent de SE.
L'attention des pilotes est attirée sur l'existence de procédures IFR et d'entraînement gros porteurs sur l'aérodrome voisin de CHATEAUROUX-DEOLS.
Absence de visibilité entre les deux seuils de piste, une extrême prudence est recommandée.
Roulage interdit hors piste et TWY.
Consignes applicables lorsque la CTR de CHATEAUROUX est active : Tours de piste : pour des tours de piste à Villers, afficher 7057 au transpondeur et contacter.
Pour l'intégration dans le circuit d'aérodrome de Villers, effectuer une verticale de Villers à 1500 pieds QNH sans déborder à l'est de l'axe de piste de Villers.

Tant que le contact radio n'a pas été établi, rester à l'ouest de l'axe de piste de Villers à 1500 pieds QNH maximum en attente de l'obtension de la clairance ; sortie possible par l'ouest à 1500 pieds QNH maximum Autres secteurs : clairance obligatoire auprès de CHATEAUROUX TWR.
